rules.candidateScope: Existing GoodsService lifecycle, owner and category predicates remain authoritative.
rules.price: goods:price:view OR goods:price:edit; selection grants and sales_order:price:view do not grant this master field.
rules.discount: goods:discount:view independently of price; absent/zero retains the document's existing default policy.
rules.stockQty: goods:view only, preserving the original master-list access used by BOM previews.
rules.salesDisplay: Sales quote/order additionally retain sales_order:price:view and the server's priceMasked flag.
rules.privateFields: No master write access, cost fields, account balances, bank/tax/contact details are granted by selecting a reference.
rules.identity: Opening, loading and confirmation belong to one monotonic account/permission/server/read-scope epoch. Revocation followed by regrant cannot revive the old selection.
